label: s2_sub_004_dokuboss_first_pop_01
text: Come one, come all! Feast thine\neyes on my special garments! ▶

label: s2_sub_004_dokuboss_first_00
text: Come one, come all![VAR 0x0114(0023)]

label: s2_sub_004_dokuboss_first_01
text: Special garments await thee![VAR 0x0114(0023)]

label: s2_sub_004_dokuboss_first_02
text: Oho?! Why, if it is not [VAR 0x0100(0000)]![VAR 0x0114(0023)]

label: s2_sub_004_dokuboss_first_03
text: I must thank thee for thine aid during our recent\nstudy session. ’Twas truly of great assistance.[VAR 0x0114(0023)]

label: s2_sub_004_select_01
text: What’re you up to?

label: s2_sub_004_select_02
text: “Special garments,” huh?

label: s2_sub_004_dokuboss_first_04
text: Ah, I see I have piqued thine interest! ’Tis clear\nthou hast a keen eye for quality.[VAR 0x0114(0023)]

label: s2_sub_004_dokuboss_first_05
text: You see, I, Atticus, had a dream that granted me\ninspiration for a range of original apparel...[VAR 0x0114(0023)]

label: s2_sub_004_dokuboss_first_06
text: I created the garments, then journey’d here to\nsell them—with the marketeers’ permission,\r\nof course.[VAR 0x0114(0023)]

label: s2_sub_004_dokuboss_first_07
text:
The goods at this fine market are peddled via
auction, as thou mayst well already know.\c
Therefore, whosoever craves my wares must first
triumph in a battle of bargaining![VAR 0x0114(0023)]

label: s2_sub_004_dokuboss_pop_01
text: [VAR 0xBD06(0000)]Who amongst you covets [VAR 0x1300(0009,0000)]\n[VAR 0x01C0(0009)]? ▶

label: s2_sub_004_dokuboss_00
text:
I offer a unique creation, design’d by mine own
hand: [VAR 0x1300(0001,0000)][VAR 0x01C1(0001)].\c
Bidding shall commence at [VAR 0x0205(0003,002C)]. Dost thou
wish to join the auction?[VAR 0x0114(0023)]

label: s2_sub_004_dokuboss_01
text: Splendid! Then let us advance together to the\nfield of battle![VAR 0x0114(0023)]

label: s2_sub_004_dokuboss_02
text:
I labored long into the night fashioning this
creation—[VAR 0x1300(0001,0000)][VAR 0x01C1(0001)].\c
I ask for [VAR 0x0205(0003,002C)] as the starting price. Now,
begin thy bidding, noble clientele! Have at ye![VAR 0x0114(0023)]

label: s2_sub_004_dokuboss_03
text: The highest bid rests at [VAR 0x0205(0003,002C)]! Pray tell, who\namongst you hath the spirit to bid again?![VAR 0x0114(0023)]

label: s2_sub_004_dokuboss_05
text: I declare this item sold to the valued patron here\nfor [VAR 0x0205(0003,002C)]![VAR 0x0114(0023)]

label: s2_sub_004_dokuboss_10
text: With that, I declare the bidding done! This\nauction’s victor is [VAR 0x0100(0000)]![VAR 0x0114(0023)]

label: s2_sub_004_dokuboss_06
text: The final price came to...[VAR 0x0205(0003,002C)]! Now come!\nClaim thy rightful prize![VAR 0x0114(0023)]

label: s2_sub_004_dokuboss_07
text: Ah, stay thy horses... It would seem thou hast\ninsufficient funds.\c\nPray return after padding thy coin purse some![VAR 0x0114(0023)]

label: s2_sub_004_dokuboss_08
text: It fills me with great joy to see thee purchase\ngarments crafted by mine own hand.[VAR 0x0114(0023)]

label: s2_sub_004_dokuboss_09
text: Rest assured—that was not the last of my works!\nLook forward with glee to my next revelation...[VAR 0x0114(0023)]

label: s2_sub_004_dokuboss_last_01
text: Ohoho! With that last purchase, thou art now the\nproud owner of all of my works![VAR 0x0114(0023)]

label: s2_sub_004_dokuboss_last_02
text: A glorious occasion! A wonderful achievement!\nI truly have no words to express my gratitude![VAR 0x0114(0023)]

label: s2_sub_004_dokuboss_last_03
text: As thanks, allow me to teach thee a pose that is\nessential for a connoisseur of the fine arts![VAR 0x0114(0023)]

label: s2_sub_004_system_01
text: You learned the [VAR 0xFF00(0008)]Glow Stick Dance emote[VAR 0xFF00(0000)] from\nAtticus![VAR 0x0114(0023)]

label: s2_sub_004_dokuboss_last_04
text: And thus the Atticus Emporium closes its doors![VAR 0x0114(0023)]

label: s2_sub_004_dokuboss_last_05
text: I bid thee farewell![VAR 0x0114(0023)]
